en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum opens at AIRSIDE Kai Tak on Tuesday
en.dek: The Swedish exhibition of more than 80 polarising dishes from 35 countries runs from 29 September to 26 November, complete with a tasting bar and a free vomit bag for every visitor.
body: The Disgusting Food Museum, a travelling exhibition first staged in Malmö, Sweden, opens on Tuesday at GATE33 Gallery inside AIRSIDE in Kai Tak, organisers said. The Hong Kong stop runs from 29 September to 26 November and features more than 80 unusual foods from 35 countries.

Visitors will encounter exhibits including Swedish surströmming, Icelandic fermented shark, Sardinian casu marzu and other polarising dishes presented through real samples, models, scent installations and interactive displays. A tasting bar allows those who wish to sample selected items under staff guidance; every ticket includes a specially made vomit bag.

Opening hours are noon to 8 pm Monday to Thursday and 11 am to 9 pm on Fridays, weekends and public holidays. Adult tickets start at HK$68 on weekdays and HK$88 at weekends, with concessions and limited early-bird passes available through Klook, Maoyan and UUTIX. The exhibition is located on the third floor of AIRSIDE and is reached via MTR Kai Tak station.

zh.headline: 「嘔心食物博物館」周二啟德AIRSIDE開幕
zh.dek: 瑞典展覽匯集35個國家逾80款爭議美食，展期至11月26日，設試食吧，每位入場者獲贈特製嘔吐袋。
body: 源自瑞典馬爾默的「嘔心食物博物館」將於周二（9月29日）在啟德AIRSIDE GATE33 Gallery開幕，展期至11月26日。展覽展出超過80款來自35個國家的爭議性食物。
展品包括瑞典鹽醃鯡魚、冰島發酵鯊魚肉、意大利薩丁尼亞活蛆芝士等，透過實物、模型、氣味裝置及互動展區呈現。展覽設有試食吧，訪客可在工作人員指導下嘗試部分食材；每位入場者均獲贈特製嘔吐袋。
開放時間為星期一至四中午12時至晚上8時，星期五至日及公眾假期上午11時至晚上9時。成人門票平日68元、周末88元起，另有學生小童長者優惠及限量早鳥票，可於Klook、貓眼及UUTIX購買。展覽位於AIRSIDE三樓，可由港鐵啟德站步行前往。
